scope: Read-only classification of the independently identified west-of-Cape-Vincent 274-cell gap; no domain/source changes.
negative_distance_meaning: Outside the artificial current 1 km-padded computational inlet; not an observed dry/land classification.
caveat: Some mapped-water cells have retrieved bed above this mean stage, so a larger cut alone would not justify wetting every cell. Existing source data could support a separately solved larger-domain scenario, but no extrapolated vectors are supplied.
